## Checklist for catalog changes

- [ ] Every `title` and `description` has both `"en"` and `"es"`.
- [ ] New tweaks set `"tested"` to the macOS major version you checked them on.
- [ ] I applied and reverted the tweak on my Mac and it behaved as described.
- [ ] Apps use a Homebrew cask token (`brew info --cask <token>` works) or an App Store id.
- [ ] `MacOSUtil --catalog validate Catalog` passes.

The signed bundle in `dist/` is regenerated by the maintainer after merging.
